text:
nina (People Ops): Heads-up — Luca's conversion contractor -> employee on 2026-02-15 created a social contributions overlap (IT invoice + NL payroll). Payslip shows duplicate employee social. Need reconciliation + off-cycle correction. @oliver can you confirm?

oliver (Payroll): Saw it in the ingestion feed. Contractor invoice for Jan was grossed and taxed in IT; NL payroll also applied employee social. Will need invoice PDF + remittance proof and the contractor TIN. @eva any immediate cash fix? :thinking_face: 

eva (Finance Ops): For cash-side we can process an off-cycle credit once docs and JE are in. Please send invoice + bank remittance to finance-payroll@redwood.com and attach here. Also confirm Luca's effective payroll start date (should be 2026-02-15).

luca (Employee): I uploaded the Jan contractor invoice and payment receipt to the HR portal yesterday (folder: onboard/luca/contractor-payments). Contractor TIN: IT12345678. My Dutch BSN was provided during onboarding. Happy to re-upload here if helpful.

oliver (Payroll): Pulling the files now. If the Jan payment was subject to INPS employee contributions, we can either reclaim or gross-adjust. Typical reclaim timeline ~6–8 weeks. For short-term needs we can process an off-cycle net correction in March and annotate for year-end adjustments. Need approval from @nina and a JE from finance. Payroll codes I'll use: `OFFCYCLE_CORR | GL:6100 | DEBIT:EMP_SOC`.

nina (People Ops): Approved — proceed with off-cycle correction. Please get manager sign-off (already pinged) and loop Legal for treaty/reclaim guidance. @marta can you advise on what paperwork Legal needs?

marta (Legal): Confirming — we'll advise on the Italy-Netherlands social security coordination and treaty implications. We'll need: (1) signed contractor declaration of social contributions paid in Italy; (2) invoice + bank remittance; (3) onboarding timeline proving NL employment start. Once we have those, Legal will draft the reclaim support letter.

oliver (Payroll): Thx. @eva can you create JE referencing `JE-2026-045-pay-corr-Luca` so I can queue the off-cycle? I'll tag the payrun with `retro-social-reclaim` for audit.

eva (Finance Ops): JE created: JE-2026-045 (description: "Off-cycle social contrib correction — Luca"). Uploaded docs to finance drive and emailed finance-payroll@redwood.com. Marked for clearing against reclaim claim.

payroll-bot: Payrun 2026-03-offcycle queued — job id 24567. Requires JE and doc attachments before processing. https://payroll.redwood.com/jobs/24567 :clipboard:

oliver (Payroll): I'll attach the files and schedule the off-cycle once JE and signed contractor declaration are in. Will update this thread when processed (or if we need to move to retro payroll).

luca (Employee): Thanks everyone — I'll forward the signed declaration and ping my manager for sign-off now. Appreciate the quick turnaround! :pray:
